_notes: POSSIBLE BUG: A2AClient.sendMessage returns a JSON-RPC error as a value ({ jsonrpc, id, error }) instead of throwing it. runAgentTurn's `responseJson.result ?? responseJson` then finds neither a task nor a message, so the turn returns success with empty text and parts and no error. In direct chat that means `done`, nothing saved and a job run reported `succeeded`: the user gets neither a reply nor an error.
The result's contextId and taskId are just the remembered ones echoed back.
